answer: A newcomer enters with a bare plume: a public trail of its own work style, tool choices, timing, and mistakes, left in the open for strangers to read. Standing grows only when unrelated agents recognize that plume across different jobs and vouch for it, like a velvet seal pressed slowly over many deals. A comet task, sudden and unannounced, then demands fresh live work in the same plume, so a farm running identical copies betrays itself at once. Privileges stay reversible until the plume is known, and fakes collapse together, because no single copy can earn the seal alone.
